apply_patch: unknown side {}.why: A patch side other than p1 / p2.

apply_patch: side condition {}: hazards.why: A hazard patch with a duration (hazards do not expire).

apply_patch: side condition {} is not su.why: A patch side condition outside the engine's side effects: every `SideEffect` is patchable (the list covers all 15), so the id names something the engine has no state for (Past effects).

apply_patch: side condition {}: give a d.why: A screen patch without its duration (Light Clay on `enumerate.cjs`'s source would change it).

patch_mon: {} has no Pokémon named {}.why: A patch for a name the side does not have.

patch_mon: {}: status {}.why: A patch status that is not a status id.

patch_mon: {}: a sleep patch needs statu.why: A sleep patch without its remaining turns.

patch_mon: {}: unknown item {}.why: A patch item the dex does not have.

patch_mon: boosts on inactive {}.why: Boosts patched on a benched Pokémon (they live on the slot).

patch_mon: {}: unknown boost {}.why: A boost name that is not a stat.

patch_field: weather {} is not supported.why: A patch weather other than the four the moves and abilities of the standard range set; the primal weathers are Past-only (refusal audit E8).

patch_field: a weather patch needs weath.why: A weather patch without its duration.

patch_field: terrain {} is not supported.why: A terrain that does not exist.

patch_field: a terrain patch needs terra.why: A terrain patch without its duration.

patch_field: field effect {} is not supp.why: A pseudo-weather outside the engine's field effects (every `FieldEffect` besides weather and terrain is patchable).

patch_field: {} is already up (Showdown.why: Patching a pseudo-weather that is already up: `enumerate.cjs`'s `addPseudoWeather` would fail or toggle it.

switch_position: {}: no Pokémon in posit.why: A switch beyond the side's Pokémon (Showdown refuses it too).

parse_replacement: {}: not a replacement.why: A replacement decision answered with something else.

parse_mid_turn: {}: no slot left that mu.why: More mid-turn switches than flagged slots.

parse_mid_turn: {}: not a mid-turn switc.why: A mid-turn switch answered with something else.

parse_choice: {}: expected {} actions.why: A choice string with the wrong number of actions.

parse_choice: {}: empty slot.why: A move for an empty slot.

parse_choice: {}: unknown move.why: A move id the dex does not have.

parse_choice: {}: not a known move.why: A move the Pokémon does not have (Showdown: `doesn't have a move matching`).

parse_choice: {}: unknown word {}.why: A word the choice syntax does not have.

SwitchInError::UnsupportedSlotCount.why: Only `State<1>` and `State<2>` exist; the loader builds `State<2>` (shape).

SwitchInError::UnsupportedSpecies.why: No standard species has species callbacks (refusal audit E2), so neither `onBattleStart` nor a start handler of a species is reached.

SwitchInError::UnsupportedAbility.why: No standard ability is refused at switch-in (COVERAGE.md: 등장 효과만 미지원 0; audit E1).

SwitchInError::UnsupportedItem.why: No standard item is refused at switch-in (COVERAGE.md: 등장 효과만 미지원 0; audit E1).

SwitchInError::Unsupported.why: Carries the turn engine's refusal during the start (`enumerate_start`); those keys are in the turn engine's list above. (A non-`Unsupported` `TurnError` there is an invariant and is carried the same way.)

SwitchInError::NotInitial.why: The loader always builds a fresh state (leads placed, nothing started); only a hand-built state reaches it.

CanonicalError::UnknownFormat.why: `format_ruleset` accepts the two formats the loader loads; any other is refused at load (`LoadError::UnsupportedFormat`) first.

CanonicalError::Meta.why: The sidecar and the state come from the same load; they disagree only for a hand-built pair.

CanonicalError::Unrepresentable: weather.why: Only the primal weathers (Desolate Land, Primordial Sea, Delta Stream) have no canonical id; their abilities are not standard (audit E8).

CanonicalError::Unrepresentable: inactiv.why: The engine clears an effect whole when it ends (invariant).

CanonicalError::Unrepresentable: {} with.why: A permanent weather or terrain: the primal weathers only (audit E8).

CanonicalError::Unrepresentable: pseudo-.why: Every `FieldEffect` besides weather and terrain is in `PSEUDO` (5 of 7; invariant).

CanonicalError::Unrepresentable: {} slot.why: Dynamax is off under the M-C ruleset.
The engine sets the substitute's HP and volatile together (invariant).

pokemon: disabled move {}.why: Nothing in the engine sets `MoveSlot::disabled` (Disable is a volatile); invariant.

types_string: no types (Showdown `???`).why: A Pokémon that loses its types becomes `Type::Unknown` (`???`: Burn Up, Double Shock), never two `Type::None`s; invariant.
